ru.title: Дистилляция поведения упряжей в веса агента для универсального развёртывания
ru.desc: В статье изучается дистилляция агентских упряжей — внешних систем, которые улучшают взаимодействие модели с окружающей средой. Авторы предлагают метод Harness-Zero, который позволяет перенести поведение, индуцированное оптимальной упряжью, в веса модели через специального агента-упряжи. Агент исправляет ответы студента перед выполнением в целевом действии, преобразуя это руководство в обучающие демонстрации. Эксперименты показывают, что после обучения специализированную упряжь можно удалить при развёртывании, при этом производительность базовой модели улучшается с 23.3% до 44.3% за счёт интернализации поведения в параметры модели.

en.title: Harness-Zero: Empowering Agents Through Knowledge Transfer
en.desc: This paper introduces a method called Harness-Zero, which focuses on improving the performance of agents in various environments by transferring knowledge from specialized harnesses to a general-purpose model. The approach involves using an optimized harness during training to guide the agent's behavior, allowing it to learn effective strategies that can be applied later without the specialized harness. The challenge addressed is the difference in action spaces and information between the optimized and target harnesses, which is overcome by using an agent-as-harness to correct actions before execution. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in task success rates and the recovery of effective behaviors, showcasing the potential of harness distillation in enhancing agent performance across different domains.

zh.title: Harness-Zero：优化代理装置的蒸馏技术
zh.desc: 本文研究了代理装置蒸馏技术，旨在通过优化的代理装置在训练过程中指导模型，从而将其行为转移到模型权重中。由于不同的代理装置在行动空间和可用信息上存在差异，直接使用优化装置的指导作为目标装置的监督存在挑战。我们提出了Harness-Zero，通过代理作为装置的方式，使得优化装置能够在目标装置的行动空间中纠正学生的响应。实验结果表明，Harness-Zero在多个领域中显著提高了模型的任务成功率，并成功恢复了基础模型中缺失的行为。

papers.title: CARE: Experience-Guided Atomic Corrective Execution for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Abstract  Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation but remain brittle once execution deviates from nominal trajectories. We propose CARE (Corrective Atomic Robotic Execution), a framework that improves recovery by learning from failures encountered during execution. Instead of generating corrective data from manually designed or random perturbations, CARE collects failed rollouts, models stage-conditioned post-failure deviations, and uses the resulting empirical distributions to synthesize representative failure states and corrective demonstrations. At inference time, CARE combines stage-wise planning with physically grounded 3D monitoring to trigger atomic adjustments or re-operations while preserving task progress. We further introduce the Failure State Recovery Benchmark (FSR-Bench), which evaluates recovery from intermediate failure states under local deviations and structural anomalies. Experiments across multiple VLA backbones, simulation benchmarks, and real-world dual-arm tasks show consistent improvements, with average task-success gains of 14.5 points in simulation and 15.9 points in the real world. Code, models, and data are available at https://github.com/xiaojunlan/care

ru.title: Обучение на собственных ошибках: восстановление робота после сбоев
ru.desc: Статья представляет CARE — фреймворк для улучшения восстановления робототехнических манипуляторов при отклонениях от запланированной траектории. Вместо использования искусственно созданных или случайных возмущений, метод собирает реальные неудачные попытки выполнения задач, моделирует отклонения после сбоев и синтезирует репрезентативные состояния отказа с корректирующими действиями. На этапе вывода система использует поэтапное планирование и физически обоснованный 3D-мониторинг для автоматического срабатывания атомарных корректировок. Эксперименты показывают прирост успешности выполнения задач на 14.5 пункта в симуляции и 15.9 пункта в реальных условиях.

en.title: Enhancing Robotic Recovery with CARE
en.desc: This paper introduces CARE, a framework designed to enhance the recovery capabilities of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies in robotic manipulation. CARE learns from execution failures by collecting data from failed attempts and modeling the deviations that occur post-failure. It synthesizes representative failure states and corrective actions, allowing robots to make informed adjustments during task execution. The framework is evaluated using the Failure State Recovery Benchmark (FSR-Bench), demonstrating significant improvements in task success rates in both simulations and real-world applications.

zh.title: 提升机器人操作的故障恢复能力
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为CARE（Corrective Atomic Robotic Execution）的框架，旨在提高机器人操作中的故障恢复能力。该框架通过学习执行过程中遇到的失败，来改善恢复效果，而不是依赖于手动设计或随机扰动生成的纠正数据。CARE收集失败的执行轨迹，建模阶段条件下的后失败偏差，并利用这些经验分布合成代表性的失败状态和纠正演示。在推理时，CARE结合阶段性规划和物理基础的3D监控，触发原子调整或重新操作，同时保持任务进度。

papers.title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Agentic memory is becoming essential for long-horizon AI agents, yet many existing systems rely on autoregressive LLMs to control how memories are organized, retrieved, and used, placing expensive generation on the critical path of memory operations. We introduce \method, a new agentic memory architecture inspired by System-One/System-Two cognition. System One captures fast, lightweight decision-making, whereas System Two performs slower, deliberative reasoning. Jev-Mem brings this division of labor to agentic memory through a dedicated System-One control plane, a structured multi-relational memory plane, and a System-Two reasoning plane. The System-One controller governs memory typing and relational organization during construction, and dynamically performs query routing, retrieval-budget allocation, graph traversal, candidate scoring, and adaptive stopping during retrieval. System Two is invoked only for complex reasoning and answer synthesis. This design improves both memory effectiveness and system efficiency: on LoCoMo Jev-Mem achieves an overall LLM-as-a-Judge score of 0.777, an 11.0\% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, while reducing memory construction time to 158\,s, a 6.6times speedup over the fastest competing memory system, and lowering average query latency to 0.93\,s, a 36.7\% reduction.
affiliations: Department of Computer Science, The University of Texas at Dallas

ru.title: Двухсистемная память для быстрых и умных агентов
ru.desc: В статье представлена Jev-Mem — архитектура памяти для интеллектуальных агентов, вдохновленная моделью двухсистемного мышления. Система разделяет работу на три компоненты: быстрый System-One контроллер для управления типизацией и организацией памяти, структурированную многоотношенческую плоскость памяти и медленный System-Two для сложного рассуждения. System-One выполняет операции маршрутизации запросов, распределения бюджета поиска и адаптивной остановки, тогда как System-Two подключается только для синтеза ответов. Подход достигает улучшения на 11% по метрике LLM-as-a-Judge и ускорения в 6.6 раз при построении памяти, значительно снижая вычислительные затраты.

en.title: Revolutionizing AI Memory with Jev-Mem: Fast Decisions, Smart Reasoning!
en.desc: This paper presents Jev-Mem, a novel architecture for agentic memory in AI systems that separates fast and slow cognitive processes, inspired by human cognition models. It utilizes a System-One control plane for quick memory organization and retrieval tasks, while a System-Two reasoning plane is reserved for complex decision-making. By optimizing memory operations, Jev-Mem enhances both the effectiveness of memory usage and the efficiency of the system, achieving significant improvements in performance metrics. The results show a notable increase in memory operation speed and a reduction in query latency compared to existing memory systems.

zh.title: 高效的代理记忆架构：Jev-Mem
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种新的代理记忆架构，名为Jev-Mem，旨在提高长时间运行的人工智能代理的记忆管理效率。该架构受到系统一和系统二认知的启发，系统一负责快速决策，而系统二则进行更复杂的推理。Jev-Mem通过专门的系统一控制平面和结构化的多关系记忆平面来优化记忆的组织和检索过程。实验结果表明，Jev-Mem在记忆构建时间和查询延迟方面均显著优于现有系统，同时在性能评分上也有显著提升。

papers.title: Why Do Video Diffusion Models Violate Physics? Unveiling the Flaws in Attention Mechanisms
papers.abstract: Abstract  Despite impressive visual quality, state-of-the-art video diffusion models often generate content that violates real-world physical laws. While existing solutions rely on external priors or specialized data, we investigate the root cause by exploring the internal mechanisms of these models. Specifically, we present the first interpretability study on the ''motion planning'' process of text-to-video diffusion models, revealing how motion trajectories form during early denoising stages. Building upon the ''first shape, then details'' finding, we combine cross-attention trajectory patterns with causal head contributions to identify a specific subset of attention heads driving motion planning. Further, our self-attention analysis shows that Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) induces excessive spatial attention decay. This causes early candidate regions to prematurely lock into physically implausible positions, suppressing reasonable trajectories in adjacent frames and triggering generation failure modes. To address this fundamental flaw, we propose a lightweight architectural modification that scales the frequency of RoPE across different denoising steps. This strategy reduces excessive attention decay, helping the model explore better candidate regions to establish coherent physical motion. Finally, training-free and training-based experiments confirm the effectiveness of our approach in enhancing the physical commonsense of generated videos.
affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

ru.title: Исправление физики движений в видео-диффузионных моделях через оптимизацию встраивания позиций
ru.desc: Исследование выявило, что современные видео-диффузионные модели генерируют физически неправдоподобные движения из-за избыточного пространственного затухания внимания, вызванного встраиванием позиций Rotary Position Embedding. Авторы провели первый анализ интерпретируемости процесса планирования движений в моделях text-to-video, обнаружив, что траектории объектов формируются на ранних этапах удаления шума и что определённые attention heads отвечают за эту функцию. Проблема заключается в том, что чрезмерное затухание внимания приводит к преждевременной фиксации кандидатских регионов в физически невозможных позициях, подавляя корректные траектории в соседних кадрах. Предложено лёгкое архитектурное решение, которое масштабирует частоту RoPE на разных этапах денойзинга, уменьшая затухание внимания и позволяя модели исследовать более подходящие области для создания физически корректных движений.

en.title: Enhancing Physical Realism in Video Generation
en.desc: This paper investigates the limitations of current video diffusion models that produce visually appealing but physically unrealistic content. The authors conduct an interpretability study on the motion planning process within these models, focusing on how motion trajectories are formed during the denoising stages. They identify that certain attention heads are responsible for motion planning and that the use of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) leads to excessive decay in spatial attention, causing the model to lock into implausible positions. To improve this, they propose a modification to the RoPE frequency across denoising steps, which enhances the model's ability to generate coherent and physically plausible motion in videos.

zh.title: 提升视频生成的物理常识
zh.desc: 本论文探讨了视频扩散模型在生成内容时违反物理法则的根本原因。我们首次对文本到视频扩散模型的“运动规划”过程进行可解释性研究，揭示了在早期去噪阶段运动轨迹的形成。通过结合交叉注意力轨迹模式和因果头的贡献，我们识别出驱动运动规划的特定注意力头。为了解决模型的基本缺陷，我们提出了一种轻量级的架构修改，减少了过度的空间注意力衰减，从而提高生成视频的物理常识。

papers.title: 1% of Tokens Can Be Enough: On Gradient Estimation in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Sparse on-policy distillation (OPD) allocates teacher supervision to a small subset of tokens in student-generated trajectories. However, useful teacher guidance can yield a noisy update when its gradient is estimated from a sampled next token. We study this estimation problem at a fixed prefix in information geometry and propose an information-efficiency ratio (IER) based on a signal-to-noise decomposition. IER characterizes relative gradient estimation error under an optimal scalar baseline. A candidate-set approximation enables token selection based on IER and its combination with existing usefulness scores, while retaining the sampled reverse-KL training objective. On mathematical and medical reasoning tasks, adding IER improves existing selectors in multiple settings, with sparse configurations matching or exceeding full OPD without token selection at small token budgets of 0.1\%--1\%. These results support accounting for both usefulness and gradient-estimation reliability when allocating sparse supervision. Our code is available at https://github.com/BruceSheng1202/IER-OPD.

ru.title: Информационная эффективность в разреженном дистиллировании языковых моделей
ru.desc: В работе исследуется проблема разреженного обучения с учителем (OPD), где учитель предоставляет рекомендации только для небольшого подмножества токенов, сгенерированных студентом. Авторы предлагают метрику информационной эффективности (IER), основанную на разложении сигнала и шума, которая характеризует ошибку оценки градиента при использовании оптимального скалярного базового уровня. Метод позволяет выбирать токены для учебного сигнала, комбинируя меру полезности с надежностью оценки градиента, сохраняя при этом обратную дивергенцию Кульбака-Лейблера как целевую функцию. На задачах математического и медицинского рассуждения добавление IER улучшает существующие селекторы и достигает производительности полного OPD при использовании только 0,1%-1% от всех токенов.

en.title: Enhancing Sparse Supervision with Information-Efficiency Ratio
en.desc: This paper introduces Sparse On-Policy Distillation (OPD), which focuses teacher supervision on a limited number of tokens in student-generated data. It addresses the challenge of noisy updates caused by gradient estimation from sampled tokens by proposing an Information-Efficiency Ratio (IER). The IER helps to evaluate the accuracy of gradient estimates and improves token selection by combining it with existing usefulness scores. The results show that using IER can enhance performance in reasoning tasks, allowing for effective sparse supervision with minimal token budgets.

zh.title: 优化稀疏监督的梯度估计
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了一种稀疏的在线策略蒸馏方法（OPD），它将教师的监督分配给学生生成轨迹中的一小部分标记。研究发现，当从采样的下一个标记估计梯度时，教师的指导可能会导致噪声更新。作者引入了信息效率比（IER），用于描述在最优标量基线下的相对梯度估计误差，并提出了一种基于IER的标记选择方法。实验结果表明，在数学和医学推理任务中，结合IER的选择器在多个设置中表现优于现有方法，且在小的标记预算下，稀疏配置的效果与完整的OPD相当或更好。

papers.title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
papers.abstract: Abstract  Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. Through extensive experiments, we develop a detailed understanding of how capabilities transfer across stages. Finally, we propose a new ACL recipe that combines offline replay over high-quality trajectories with a routed network of multiple LoRA experts each specialized via RL, substantially improving the agent's ability to learn across multiple domains. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning and agentic tasks, evaluated under both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate the value of our analysis and the effectiveness of our approach.

ru.title: Непрерывное обучение многоцелевых агентов без катастрофального забывания
ru.desc: В статье изучается проблема непрерывного обучения агентов (ACL), когда модель должна последовательно овладевать несколькими навыками без забывания ранее полученных знаний. Авторы предлагают ACLArena — систему для анализа и оценки различных подходов к интеграции способностей, изучая механизмы забывания и обобщения как на уровне модели, так и на уровне токенов. Они сравнивают три основные парадигмы: дистилляцию знаний от нескольких учителей, самодистилляцию и объединение моделей. На основе полученных insights авторы предлагают новый метод ACL, комбинирующий воспроизведение траекторий с маршрутизируемой сетью специализированных LoRA-экспертов, обученных с применением RL.

en.title: Enhancing Agent Learning: A New Framework for Continual Capability Integration
en.desc: This paper presents ACLArena, a framework designed to study Agent Continual Learning (ACL) in industrial applications. It addresses the challenges of integrating multiple learning capabilities acquired at different training stages, focusing on the issues of forgetting and generalization. The authors analyze various integration methods, including multi-teacher distillation and model merging, to understand how to retain previously learned skills while acquiring new ones. Their proposed ACL recipe enhances learning across domains by combining offline replay with specialized networks, showing significant improvements in performance across various tasks.

zh.title: 提升代理学习能力的新方法
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为ACLArena的框架，用于研究和评估代理的持续学习（ACL）。我们构建了一个顺序训练管道，并从模型层面和标记层面分析遗忘和泛化的机制。通过比较多教师在线蒸馏、自我蒸馏微调和模型合并，我们评估了这些方法在保留新学习能力的同时恢复先前学习能力的效果。最后，我们提出了一种新的ACL方案，结合高质量轨迹的离线重放和多个通过强化学习专门化的LoRA专家网络，显著提高了代理在多个领域的学习能力。

papers.title: HuRo: Robotizing Human Videos for Scalable VLA Pretraining
papers.abstract: Abstract  Human video datasets offer an abundant and diverse source of interaction data that can complement expensive real-robot data. To bridge the human-to-robot embodiment gap, existing approaches either robotize videos in task-matched settings or address observation and action alignment separately at scale. In this work, we systematically examine whether robotized human videos can serve as an effective and scalable source of supervision for VLA pretraining. To this end, we develop a robotization pipeline that converts heterogeneous human videos into robot-aligned observations and action trajectories while inferring missing intermediate signals across annotation levels. Using this pipeline, we construct the HuRo dataset, comprising about 630K robotized episodes and 142M processed frames from five human-video sources. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, increasing the amount of robotized pretraining data improves overall completion from 51.5% to 80.3% and OOD completion under spatial and visual shifts from 34.9% to 72.2%. Ablations further show that visual robotization improves OOD robustness and that end-to-end pretraining with retargeted actions outperforms visual-only transfer. Project website: https://3587jjh.github.io/HuRo.

ru.title: От человеческих видео к роботизированному предварительному обучению через автоматическую роботизацию
ru.desc: В этой работе исследователи разработали конвейер роботизации, который преобразует видео с участием людей в данные, пригодные для обучения робототехнических систем, автоматически выравнивая наблюдения и действия на разных уровнях аннотации. На основе этого конвейера они создали датасет HuRo с 630K эпизодов и 142M кадров, полученных из пяти источников видео с участием людей. Авторы демонстрируют, что увеличение объема предварительного обучения на роботизированных видео значительно улучшает производительность на реальных манипуляционных задачах, повышая успешность выполнения с 51.5% до 80.3% и робастность к распределению данных с 34.9% до 72.2%. Результаты показывают, что визуальная роботизация и переобучение действий на основе трансфертного обучения являются ключевыми факторами для повышения устойчивости к визуальным и пространственным смещениям.

en.title: Transforming Human Videos into Robot Training Data for Better Performance
en.desc: This paper explores how human video datasets can be transformed into useful training data for robots. The authors introduce a robotization pipeline that converts diverse human videos into formats that robots can understand, creating a new dataset called HuRo. By using this dataset, they demonstrate that more robotized training data significantly enhances the performance of robots in real-world tasks. The findings suggest that combining visual data with action retargeting leads to better outcomes, especially in challenging scenarios.

zh.title: 利用人类视频提升机器人学习效果
zh.desc: 本研究探讨了如何利用人类视频数据来提升机器人学习的效果。我们开发了一种机器人化流程，将不同的人类视频转换为与机器人对齐的观察和动作轨迹。通过这一流程，我们构建了HuRo数据集，包含约63万条机器人化的剧集和1.42亿帧处理过的图像。实验结果表明，增加机器人化的预训练数据显著提高了机器人在实际操作任务中的完成率。

papers.title: Think Like a World Model, Act Like a VLA: Distilling World-Model Representations into Compact Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Abstract  Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map observations to actions with no objective that accounts for how the world responds, so their robustness is bounded primarily by data coverage. World models carry precisely that missing objective and are better grounded for it, yet rolling the future forward costs seconds per decision and rules them out of the control loop. We show the two can be separated. What a world model knows about physical scenes lives in its internal features; generating the future is merely the objective that produced them, so the grounding can be inherited while the generative machinery is left behind. We add one feature-alignment term to ordinary VLA training: a frozen world model is run over the training frames once and cached, and the student learns to agree with that cache. No teacher is loaded during training, the projector is discarded after it, and the deployed policy is identical to the undistilled baseline, running in 32~ms and 1.86~GB on a consumer RTX~5090, so every gain is attributable to the representation rather than to added capacity or test-time compute. A 0.8B student reaches 97.9% on LIBERO, improves from 48.2% to 50.5% on RoboCasa-GR1 humanoid manipulation, and the same objective carries over to real hardware, on both a single-arm and a bimanual platform. The gain survives changes of student scale, backbone, alignment layer, and teacher, indicating a broad representational prior rather than a fragile alignment between two particular networks. Project page: https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/.

ru.title: Заимствование знаний физики: как world models улучшают действия без замедления
ru.desc: Исследование предлагает способ улучшить Vision-Language-Action модели, которые управляют роботами, путём заимствования представлений из world models без замедления. World models обучаются предсказывать будущие кадры и усваивают полезное понимание физического мира, но их использование слишком медленно для управления в реальном времени. Авторы показывают, что можно скопировать только внутренние признаки world model в обычную VLA модель через дополнительный loss функцию при обучении, оставляя саму сеть незаменённой. Метод не требует учителя во время вывода и сохраняет исходную скорость модели, при этом значительно улучшая качество управления роботом как в симуляции, так и на реальном оборудовании.

en.title: Enhancing VLA Models with Efficient World Model Insights
en.desc: This paper introduces a method to enhance Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by integrating insights from world models without the computational burden of generating future predictions. The authors propose a feature-alignment approach where a frozen world model is used to create a cache of internal features, which the VLA model learns to align with during training. This method allows the VLA model to inherit the grounding knowledge of the world model while maintaining efficiency in decision-making. The results show significant performance improvements on various tasks, demonstrating that the gains are due to better representation rather than increased model complexity.

zh.title: 通过世界模型提升VLA模型的鲁棒性
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型训练方法，通过引入世界模型来增强模型的鲁棒性。世界模型提供了对物理场景的理解，而生成未来的过程则被视为一种目标，这样可以将两者分开。我们在普通的VLA训练中添加了一个特征对齐项，通过冻结的世界模型对训练帧进行处理并缓存，学生模型学习与该缓存一致。实验结果表明，这种方法在多个任务上显著提高了性能，同时保持了模型的计算效率。

papers.title: Towards Full Pipeline FP8 Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
papers.abstract: Abstract  Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key technique for improving the reasoning and agentic abilities of large language models (LLMs). Although FP8 quantization can accelerate RL training, maintaining stability throughout an FP8 RL pipeline remains challenging. While previous works have focused on resolving train-inference mismatches using correction techniques like TIS, we reveal that full-pipeline FP8 RL still suffers from severe training instability, manifesting as anomalous mid-training entropy surges and garbled outputs. We trace this instability to a previously overlooked cause: compounded FP8 quantization noise distorts the importance ratio, disproportionately pushing negative-advantage tokens outside the trust region and erroneously zeroing out their gradients. As a result, pathological outputs are not properly penalized and accumulate over the course of training. To address this, we propose Calibrated Clipping, a dynamic method that aligns the FP8 clipping bounds with high-precision BF16 distributions by matching the lower-bound clipping quantile and rebalancing the upper bound accordingly. Extensive experiments across GRPO and DAPO algorithms, model scales from 8B to 32B, and multiple FP8 scaling granularities demonstrate that our approach successfully eliminates entropy surges and restores performance comparable to the BF16 baseline.

ru.title: Стабилизация обучения с подкреплением больших моделей через калибровку квантования
ru.desc: В работе исследуется проблема нестабильности обучения при использовании 8-битного квантования (FP8) в процессе обучения больших языковых моделей методом обучения с подкреплением. Авторы выявили, что накопление ошибок квантования приводит к искажению коэффициента важности (importance ratio) в алгоритмах PPO-подобного типа, что вызывает патологические выбросы энтропии и деградацию качества генерируемого текста. Для решения этой проблемы предложен метод Calibrated Clipping, который динамически подстраивает границы отсечения при квантовании в соответствии с распределением высокоточных вычислений в формате BF16. Экспериментальная оценка показывает, что предложенный подход успешно устраняет нестабильность и восстанавливает производительность, сравнимую с базовой моделью без квантования.

en.title: Stabilizing FP8 Reinforcement Learning with Calibrated Clipping
en.desc: This paper discusses the challenges of using FP8 quantization in reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs). It identifies that training instability occurs due to compounded FP8 quantization noise, which affects the importance ratio and leads to poor gradient updates. The authors propose a solution called Calibrated Clipping, which adjusts the clipping bounds to better align with high-precision BF16 distributions. Their experiments show that this method effectively stabilizes training and improves performance, matching the results of traditional BF16 methods.

zh.title: 校准剪切：提升FP8强化学习稳定性
zh.desc: 强化学习（RL）已成为提升大型语言模型（LLM）推理和智能能力的关键技术。尽管FP8量化可以加速RL训练，但在FP8 RL管道中保持稳定性仍然具有挑战性。我们发现，FP8量化噪声的累积会扭曲重要性比率，导致负优势标记被错误地推离信任区域，从而产生异常的训练不稳定性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了校准剪切（Calibrated Clipping）方法，通过动态调整FP8剪切边界，使其与高精度BF16分布对齐，从而消除熵激增现象。

papers.title: The Functionalizer: Lossless Functional Decomposition for Subword Tokenization
papers.abstract: Abstract  Standard subword tokenizers either treat every orthographic variation of a word (such as hello, Hello, HELLO, and Héllo) as unrelated vocabulary entries, which fragments the embedding space, or discard this variation through lossy normalization. We present the Functionalizer, a lossless pre-tokenizer framework that factors orthographic and structural variations into a compositional opcode/operand prefix stream before tokenization: a canonical base token (operand) prefixed by parametric transformation operators (opcodes) encoded in the Unicode Private Use Area. We introduce operators covering casing (CAPITALIZE), diacritics (13 dedicated opcodes), and character repetition (REPEAT, MULTIREPEAT), which are fully reversible. Across natural language and code corpora, the Functionalizer enables complete corpus coverage with significantly smaller vocabularies under unconstrained exhaustion conditions, reducing actual vocabulary slot requirements by up to 19.7%. Downstream evaluations on 98M-parameter GPT-2 models show that the Functionalizer improves Python code syntax validity (9.12% vs. 7.70%) while reducing duplicate n-gram repetition in natural language prose. These findings demonstrate that functional decomposition can be an effective mechanism for vocabulary-efficient, structurally aware language modeling, and motivate further validation at production scale.

ru.title: Функциональная декомпозиция для словарь-эффективной токенизации
ru.desc: В работе предлагается Functionalizer — инновационный предварительный токенизатор, который разложает орфографические вариации слов (например, hello, Hello, HELLO) на канонический базовый токен и обратимые операторы преобразования (капитализация, диакритика, повторение символов), закодированные в приватной области Unicode. Этот подход избегает фрагментации пространства эмбеддингов и позволяет достичь полного покрытия корпуса с существенно меньшим размером словаря — сокращением требуемых слотов на до 19,7%. Экспериментальная оценка на GPT-2 моделях показывает улучшение синтаксической корректности кода на Python (9,12% против 7,70%) и снижение дублирования n-грамм в естественном языке. Результаты демонстрируют эффективность функциональной декомпозиции для создания словарной оптимизации и структурно-осознанного языкового моделирования.

en.title: Efficient Language Modeling with Functionalizer: A New Approach to Tokenization
en.desc: The paper introduces the Functionalizer, a new pre-tokenization framework that addresses the limitations of standard subword tokenizers by preserving orthographic variations of words. It uses a system of compositional operators that encode variations like casing and diacritics, allowing for lossless representation of these differences. This approach results in a smaller vocabulary size while maintaining complete coverage of the corpus, leading to more efficient language modeling. Evaluations show that models using the Functionalizer perform better in syntax validity and reduce redundancy in text generation.

zh.title: 功能分解：高效的语言建模新方法
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种新的预标记化框架，称为Functionalizer，旨在解决标准子词标记器在处理单词的不同书写变体时的不足。它通过将正字法和结构变体分解为可组合的操作码和操作数前缀流，从而实现无损标记化。Functionalizer引入了多种操作符，能够处理大小写、变音符号和字符重复等问题，且这些操作是完全可逆的。实验结果表明，Functionalizer在自然语言和代码语料库中显著减少了词汇量需求，同时提高了代码语法的有效性。

papers.title: Complex KDA: Understanding and Enhancing the Expressivity of Kimi Delta Attention
papers.abstract: Abstract  Linear RNNs based on the delta-rule enable efficient sequence modeling, but their linear updates with a low-rank correction constrain their expressivity. Prior work has shown that composing two delta-rule transitions in a single recurrent update can model a 2D rotation, but this increases the rank and the cost of the updates compared to a single transition. We show that Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) can realize 2D rotations by combining a single delta-rule transformation with a second reflection supplied by its channel-wise gate. This requires extending the parameter ranges of KDA by combining two existing range extensions: allowing gates in [-1,1] and the delta-rule coefficient β in [0,2]. We call the resulting model Complex KDA (CKDA). It preserves KDA's stability and efficiency, with transitions that remain diagonal-plus-rank-one and non-expansive, while reaching the state-tracking expressivity of DeltaProduct_2. We characterize the expressivity of CKDA and prove that every orthogonal diagonal-plus-rank-one matrix is exactly a CKDA transition matrix. A single CKDA layer can track every finite group isomorphic to a subgroup of SO(3), and many state-tracking results use one fewer layer for CKDA compared to other diagonal-plus-rank-one Linear RNNs. Empirically, combining both extensions yields the strongest length extrapolation among tested KDA range settings on S_3, S_4, and periodic audio continuation. In language modeling, CKDA outperforms Transformers and other linear RNNs, obtains similar results to a KDA baseline, and shows promising scaling behavior. Our code is open source at https://github.com/OpenEuroLLM/ComplexKDA and our models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/openeurollm/complexkda.

ru.title: Эффективные линейные RNN с комплексными ротациями для масштабируемого моделирования последовательностей
ru.desc: В работе представлена улучшенная архитектура Complex KDA, которая расширяет возможности линейных рекуррентных нейронных сетей на основе дельта-правила для эффективного моделирования последовательностей. Авторы показали, что комбинация одного дельта-преобразования с отражением, обеспеченным канальным гейтом, позволяет реализовать двумерные повороты без увеличения вычислительной сложности. Теоретически доказано, что каждая ортогональная диагональная матрица плюс ранг-один точно соответствует переходной матрице CKDA, что обеспечивает моделирование конечных групп. Эмпирически модель демонстрирует превосходные результаты в задачах экстраполяции длинных последовательностей и языкового моделирования, конкурируя с трансформерами при значительно меньшей вычислительной стоимости.

en.title: Unlocking Sequence Modeling with Complex KDA
en.desc: The paper introduces Complex KDA (CKDA), an advanced model for sequence modeling that enhances the expressivity of linear recurrent neural networks (RNNs) by combining delta-rule transformations with channel-wise gates. CKDA achieves 2D rotations and maintains stability and efficiency by using diagonal-plus-rank-one transitions, while extending the parameter ranges for gates and delta-rule coefficients. This model can track complex state dynamics and outperforms traditional models like Transformers in language tasks, demonstrating superior performance in length extrapolation and state tracking. The authors provide open-source code and models to facilitate further research and application of CKDA.

zh.title: 复杂KDA：高效的线性递归神经网络新模型
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的线性递归神经网络模型，称为复杂Kimi Delta Attention（CKDA），它通过结合单一的delta规则变换和通道门的反射来实现二维旋转。CKDA扩展了参数范围，使得模型在保持稳定性和效率的同时，能够实现更高的表达能力。研究表明，CKDA能够追踪每个有限群体，并在语言建模任务中超越了传统的变换器和其他线性递归神经网络。实验结果显示，CKDA在长度外推和状态跟踪方面表现优异，具有良好的扩展性。

papers.title: SkillSpec: Intent-Masked Specification Reasoning for Agent Skill Correctness
papers.abstract: Abstract SkillSpec uses specification reasoning over a unified skill graph to detect semantic defects in autonomous agent skills by balancing contextual views and sandbox validation.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Autonomous agent systems increasingly depend on reusable skill abstractions for consolidating experiential knowledge and domain expertise. These artifacts typically bundle free-form instructions with heterogeneous resources. However, ensuring their correctness remains challenging. Their failure modes transcend conventional code defects to subtle semantic inconsistencies such as intent conflicts, which manifest as silent failures masked by the underlying model. Moreover, skill correctness must be grounded in intended task boundaries and generalizability. We propose SkillSpec, a Hoare-style framework that formulates skill correctness as a specification reasoning problem. It transforms a heterogeneous skill repository into a unified graph representation that aligns descriptions, instructions and code artifacts. For each node, SkillSpec derives an ExpectSpec from the surrounding declared intent, and infers FactSpecs from encoded behavior under partially disclosed intent. An intent mask regulates access to holistic, lineage, neighborhood, and local views to balance the bias introduced by excessive context against unsupported inference caused by insufficient context. SkillSpec jointly reasons over these views to flag candidate defects, and automatically validates them in an isolated sandbox. On 515 real-world skills from SkillsBench and widely downloaded repositories, SkillSpec identified 763 manually confirmed defects across 239 skills, achieving 61.2% precision. The node-level analysis across multiple model families shows that specification reasoning is consistently reliable for code nodes, whereas plain-text nodes remain a major bottleneck. Most defects arise at the boundaries between declared intent and implementation, demonstrating that explicit specifications provide a practical foundation for skill quality assurance in real-world agent ecosystems.

ru.title: Спецификационное рассуждение для гарантии качества навыков агентов
ru.desc: SkillSpec — это фреймворк для обнаружения семантических дефектов в навыках автономных агентов, использующий спецификационное рассуждение над единым графом навыков. Система трансформирует репозиторий навыков в граф, который выравнивает описания, инструкции и код, затем выводит формальные спецификации ожидаемого поведения. Для балансирования предвзятости от избыточного контекста и необоснованных выводов от недостаточного контекста используется маска намерения, регулирующая доступ к разным видам контекста. Метод обнаруживает дефекты путём совместного рассуждения над несколькими представлениями и автоматической валидации в изолированной песочнице.

en.title: Ensuring Skill Quality with Specification Reasoning
en.desc: SkillSpec is a framework designed to improve the reliability of autonomous agent skills by identifying semantic defects through specification reasoning. It creates a unified skill graph that connects various skill components, allowing for a comprehensive analysis of intent and behavior. By deriving expectations and facts from the skills' context, SkillSpec can detect inconsistencies that traditional methods might miss. The framework has proven effective, identifying numerous defects in real-world skills, highlighting the importance of clear specifications for ensuring skill quality.

zh.title: SkillSpec：提升自主代理技能的质量保证
zh.desc: SkillSpec 是一个框架，用于通过统一的技能图进行规范推理，以检测自主代理技能中的语义缺陷。它将异构的技能库转化为统一的图形表示，确保描述、指令和代码的一致性。SkillSpec 通过推导期望规范和事实规范，平衡过多上下文带来的偏差与不足上下文导致的推理不支持。该方法在真实世界的技能中成功识别了大量缺陷，证明了明确规范在技能质量保证中的重要性。

papers.title: Realtime-Venus: A full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation
papers.abstract: Abstract A proactive full-duplex system with separate audio-visual and audio models enables continuous perception, native speech generation, and asynchronous tool execution for real-time dialogue.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Natural interaction in digital and physical environments requires continuous perception and timely responses. Spoken dialogue relies on acoustic and linguistic cues, while video interaction also requires grounding the conversation in evolving visual context. We present Realtime-Venus, a proactive full-duplex interaction system with two separately trained 9B models: Realtime-Venus-Omni for audio-visual interaction and Realtime-Venus-Audio for spoken interaction. Each model serves as a complete conversational frontend, integrating continuous perception, conversational control, and native speech generation through a shared causal timeline for user inputs, model outputs, and delegation events.   A dual-loop runtime coordinates live interaction with background reasoning and tool execution. Foreground interaction continues while Realtime-Venus-Harness executes tasks asynchronously and returns results for integration into the ongoing dialogue.   Both models follow a common post-training recipe combining offline understanding, proactive full-duplex trajectories, and delegation workflows.   Among the evaluated online models, Realtime-Venus-Omni achieves the highest scores on six of eight video benchmarks, including StreamingBench (70.2%), OVO-Bench (64.7%), and Daily-Omni (81.3%). Across eight audio understanding and spoken question answering benchmarks, Realtime-Venus-Audio leads the compared models on MMAU (78.0%), MMAU-Pro (63.2%), Llama Questions (83.8%), and Speech CMMLU (67.8%), while matching the best VoiceBench AlpacaEval score of 4.81. On Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5, Realtime-Venus-Audio responds to 75% of user interruptions and achieves continuation rates of 97%, 88%, and 86% under backchannels, other-directed speech, and background speech, respectively, exceeding Gemini 3.1 Live and GPT-4o on all three continuation metrics.

ru.title: Полнодуплексный диалог в реальном времени с аудио-визуальной грамотностью
ru.desc: В работе представлена система Realtime-Venus для реального времени взаимодействия, состоящая из двух независимо обученных моделей размером 9B параметров: одна для аудио-визуального взаимодействия, другая для речевого диалога. Система обеспечивает непрерывное восприятие входных данных, генерацию речи в реальном времени и асинхронное выполнение инструментов благодаря двойному циклу выполнения, который координирует переднеплановое взаимодействие с фоновым рассуждением. Обе модели обучены на общем рецепте, объединяющем офлайн понимание, проактивные полнодуплексные траектории и рабочие процессы делегирования. Модели показывают лучшие результаты на множестве бенчмарков видео- и аудио-понимания, включая StreamingBench (70.2%), OVO-Bench (64.7%) и Daily-Omni (81.3%) для визуального взаимодействия, а также демонстрируют превосходные результаты в обработке прерываний пользователя и продолжении диалога.

en.title: Seamless Dialogue with Proactive Full-Duplex Interaction
en.desc: The paper introduces Realtime-Venus, a proactive full-duplex interaction system designed for seamless audio-visual and spoken dialogue. It utilizes two distinct 9B models, Realtime-Venus-Omni for audio-visual tasks and Realtime-Venus-Audio for spoken interactions, enabling continuous perception and native speech generation. The system features a dual-loop runtime that allows for real-time interaction while executing background tasks asynchronously, enhancing the dialogue experience. Performance evaluations show that both models excel in their respective benchmarks, outperforming existing models in various audio and video tasks.

zh.title: 实时对话的全新体验
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为Realtime-Venus的主动全双工交互系统，该系统使用两个独立训练的模型，分别用于音频-视觉交互和语音交互。该系统能够实现持续感知、原生语音生成和异步工具执行，从而支持实时对话。通过共享的因果时间线，用户输入、模型输出和任务委派事件得以整合，确保对话的流畅进行。Realtime-Venus在多个视频和音频理解基准测试中表现优异，展示了其在实时交互中的高效性和准确性。

papers.title: A Lie Detector Test for Language Models: Reading Knowledge a Model Won't Reveal
papers.abstract: Abstract  Large language models can hold knowledge they do not report. A model may sandbag on a capability evaluation, or answer against what it internally knows, and its outputs alone cannot tell whether it is hiding an answer or simply does not have one. We borrow the Concealed Information Test, a forensic method that identifies guilty knowledge by presenting a suspect with the true detail among plausible decoys and measuring a stronger response to the item they recognize. Our method, Probe of Internal Recognition (PIR), does the same inside a model. It presents a question with its candidate answers and reads, from the model's internal states, which candidate the model recognizes as correct. PIR is reference-free, needing no honest reference model and no labeled truth corpus. Across eight models from five families (Gemma, Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and Phi), PIR recovers the recognized answer at 0.70 to 0.87 balanced accuracy, well above the 0.28 to 0.40 unknown-item baseline and the 0.25 chance rate. It stays readable across every form of concealment we test, from prompted deception and trained sandbagging to external password-locked and circuit-broken checkpoints, with recognition between 0.85 and 0.93. When the model hides a known answer, recognition stays high. When unlearning removes the knowledge, recognition drops to the level of a question the model never knew. PIR therefore separates a model that will not answer from one that cannot, which supports sandbagging audits and unlearning verification. The signal is causal, adds information beyond black-box behavioral cues, and extends from multiple-choice questions to free-form generation.

ru.title: Раскрытие скрытых знаний языковых моделей через анализ внутренних состояний
ru.desc: Исследователи разработали метод Probe of Internal Recognition (PIR), который позволяет обнаружить скрытые знания в больших языковых моделях через анализ их внутренних состояний. Метод заимствует идею из криминалистики и определяет, какой ответ модель на самом деле признает правильным, представляя вопрос с несколькими вариантами ответов. PIR успешно различает ситуации, когда модель не может ответить, и когда она намеренно скрывает известный ей ответ, с точностью от 70 до 87 процентов. Метод работает без необходимости в эталонной честной модели или размеченных данных и остается эффективным даже при различных попытках сокрытия информации.

en.title: Unveiling Hidden Knowledge in Language Models with PIR
en.desc: This paper introduces a method called Probe of Internal Recognition (PIR) to uncover hidden knowledge in large language models. PIR uses a technique similar to the Concealed Information Test, where the model is presented with a question and multiple answer choices to determine which answer it recognizes as correct. The method achieves high accuracy in identifying recognized answers across various models, outperforming baseline measures. By distinguishing between models that are withholding answers and those that lack knowledge, PIR enhances the understanding of model behavior and supports audits and verification processes.

zh.title: 揭示模型隐藏知识的内部识别探测
zh.desc: 大型语言模型可能会隐藏它们所知道的知识。我们提出了一种方法，称为内部识别探测（PIR），它通过向模型提出问题并分析其内部状态来识别模型所认可的答案。PIR不需要参考模型或标记的真相数据集，能够在多种情况下有效识别答案。我们的实验表明，PIR在不同模型中表现出色，能够区分模型是故意不回答还是确实不知道答案。

papers.title: Mira-Scene: Pixel-Aligned Layouts for Generative 3D Scene
papers.abstract: Abstract  Single-image 3D object generation can now produce high-fidelity assets, yet accurately placing them into a coherent scene layout remains an open challenge. A central difficulty lies in how object layout is represented. Holistic methods absorb placement into a scene-level generation process, sacrificing object-level detail. Compositional methods preserve object fidelity by decoupling geometry from layout, but typically parameterize layout as sparse, unbounded pose variables that are difficult to learn and generalize poorly under scarce scene-level supervision.We present Mira-Scene, a compositional 3D scene reconstruction framework that replaces sparse pose regression with dense, bounded correspondence recovery. At its core is the Canonical Coordinate Map (CCM), a pixel-aligned field that maps each visible object pixel to a surface coordinate in the object's bounded canonical space. When paired with a scene-space Point Cloud Map (PCM) from monocular geometry estimation, CCM induces dense canonical-to-scene correspondences from which object transformations are recovered through robust geometric alignment. Because CCM operates in bounded canonical space, it provides a stable prediction target that can be trained from scalable object-level 3D data without requiring scene-level layout annotations. Mira-Scene further introduces a multimodal diffusion transformer that jointly generates object geometry and CCMs, using modality-specific expert streams with shared attention and positional encoding to promote geometry-layout consistency. Experiments on indoor, outdoor, synthetic, and in-the-wild scenes show that Mira-Scene substantially outperforms strong baselines in layout accuracy, achieving relative gains of 39.8% in 3D-IoU and 16.5% in 2D-IoU over SAM3D, using limited open-source training data.

ru.title: От редких поз к плотным соответствиям: композиционная реконструкция 3D сцен
ru.desc: В работе предложен Mira-Scene — компositional фреймворк для реконструкции 3D сцен из одного изображения, который решает проблему точного размещения объектов в сцене. Вместо традиционного регрессионного подхода с разреженными переменными позы авторы используют плотное восстановление соответствий через Canonical Coordinate Map (CCM) — поле, выравненное по пикселям, которое отображает каждый видимый пиксель объекта на координату в его канонической системе. Модель обучается с помощью multimodal diffusion трансформера, который совместно генерирует геометрию объектов и CCM, используя специализированные потоки экспертов для каждой модальности. Экспериментальные результаты показывают значительное превосходство над базовыми методами, включая 39.8% относительное улучшение по 3D-IoU на разнообразных сценах.

en.title: Mira-Scene: Bridging Object Fidelity and Scene Layout in 3D Generation
en.desc: The paper introduces Mira-Scene, a novel framework for generating 3D scenes from single images while maintaining high object fidelity and accurate layout. It addresses the challenge of representing object placement by using a Canonical Coordinate Map (CCM) that provides dense, pixel-aligned correspondences between object pixels and their canonical space. This approach allows for robust geometric alignment and transformation recovery without needing extensive scene-level annotations. Additionally, Mira-Scene employs a multimodal diffusion transformer to ensure consistency between object geometry and layout, significantly improving layout accuracy in various scene types.

zh.title: Mira-Scene：提升3D场景布局准确性的创新框架
zh.desc: 单图像3D物体生成技术已经能够生成高保真资产，但将这些物体准确放置在一个连贯的场景布局中仍然是一个挑战。Mira-Scene提出了一种组合式3D场景重建框架，通过密集的、有限的对应关系恢复，替代了稀疏的姿态回归方法。该框架的核心是规范坐标图（CCM），它将每个可见物体像素映射到物体的有限规范空间中的表面坐标。Mira-Scene还引入了一种多模态扩散变换器，联合生成物体几何和CCM，以促进几何与布局的一致性。

papers.title: Measuring the Checker: Mutation Analysis for GPU-Kernel Benchmark Oracles
papers.abstract: Abstract  Benchmarks for LLM-generated GPU kernels decide correctness with a few random inputs and a loose floating-point tolerance, and their verdicts now feed leaderboards and reinforcement-learning rewards. Recent work agrees these checkers are weak and patches them by hand---extra input distributions, fuzzing recipes, tighter tolerances---with no way to measure whether any patch suffices. We introduce mutation analysis as an adequacy metric for kernel-benchmark oracles: deterministic rules inject 10{,}303 compilable faults into verified CUDA implementations of 188 KernelBench problems, 7{,}384 of them with an independent kill witness; any test protocol is scored by the fraction it detects. The official check misses one in six witnessed faults (16.9%), deterministically, and the misses are skewed by family: 8.7% of arithmetic faults escape, but 78.6% of precision faults do. The metric explains why (a tolerance blind band growing with reduction size; a measured ceiling on input aggressiveness set by legitimate floating-point variance), audits the strongest existing patch (KernelBench-Verified's gain splits into +4.0 points from hidden inputs and +4.5 from tighter tolerance, a split its authors could not compute), and exposes a published fuzzing recipe that rejects correct kernels 107 times. Optimizing suites over the kill matrix reaches 98.0% detection with two inputs per problem (94.8% held-out), and the measurement's fault taxonomy teaches a test generator more than the raw faults themselves. Across 48 whole architectures, the blindness grows with scale, concentrating in deep homogeneous pipelines, and two problems prove unrefereeable: their official references violate the benchmark's own tolerance against fp64. We release everything as https://huggingface.co/datasets/Elfsong/KernelBench-M{KernelBench-M}.

ru.title: Анализ мутаций для объективной оценки качества тестирования GPU ядер
ru.desc: В работе предложен метод анализа мутаций для оценки качества тестовых оракулов в бенчмарках GPU ядер, генерируемых LLM. Исследователи внедрили 10,303 компилируемых ошибок в CUDA реализации и измерили, какую долю дефектов обнаруживают существующие проверки. Результаты показали, что стандартная проверка пропускает 16.9% ошибок, причём погрешность варьируется по типам: только 8.7% арифметических ошибок остаются необнаруженными, а вот 78.6% ошибок точности ускользают. Метод позволяет объективно оценить адекватность тестовых наборов и оптимизировать их для достижения 98% обнаружения дефектов.

en.title: Enhancing GPU Kernel Testing with Mutation Analysis
en.desc: This paper critiques the current benchmarks used to evaluate the correctness of GPU kernels generated by large language models (LLMs). It highlights the inadequacies of existing checkers, which often miss significant faults due to loose tolerances and limited input distributions. The authors propose a new metric called mutation analysis, which systematically injects faults into CUDA implementations to assess the effectiveness of test protocols. Their findings reveal that many faults go undetected, particularly precision faults, and they provide a comprehensive dataset to improve future testing methodologies.

zh.title: 变异分析：提升GPU内核正确性检测的有效性
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的评估方法，称为变异分析，用于检测大型语言模型生成的GPU内核的正确性。通过在经过验证的CUDA实现中注入10303个可编译的故障，研究者能够量化现有基准测试的有效性。结果显示，官方检查器在检测故障时存在显著的漏检率，尤其是在精度故障方面。该研究不仅优化了测试协议，还揭示了现有修补方法的不足之处，推动了更高效的故障检测技术的发展。

papers.title: ShieldVLA: Feasibility-Aware Safety Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong generalization in robotic manipulation and navigation, but existing fine-tuning methods provide limited safety guarantees. Current approaches primarily rely on Lagrangian optimization that enforces safety through soft penalties on expected cumulative cost, often resulting in residual constraint violations or overly conservative behavior. Moreover, learning safety in visual domains is challenging due to the absence of dense per-step safety annotations. We propose ShieldVLA, a safety-aligned fine-tuning framework for VLA models based on Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability. ShieldVLA learns a model-free approximation of the HJ reachability value function directly from visual observations to estimate the safe operating region. The learned safety critic gates policy optimization by separating reward maximization within feasible regions from recovery near unsafe states, avoiding persistent reward-cost trade-offs. To enable scalable supervision in visual environments, we introduce rubric-based VLM safety scores that convert semantic safety feedback into structured critic targets without requiring manual cost labels. Across five navigation and manipulation benchmarks spanning multiple VLA backbones, ShieldVLA reduces cumulative safety cost by 57% on average and improves task success rate by +0.13 over SafeVLA.

ru.title: Безопасность роботов через обучаемого критика достижимости
ru.desc: В статье представлена ShieldVLA — фреймворк для безопасной настройки Vision-Language-Action моделей, основанный на теории достижимости Hamilton-Jacobi. Метод обучает критика безопасности без разметки данных, напрямую из визуальных наблюдений, чтобы оценить безопасную область работы робота. Предложенный подход разделяет максимизацию награды в допустимых регионах от восстановления поведения вблизи небезопасных состояний, избегая компромиссов между эффективностью и безопасностью. Экспериментальные результаты показывают снижение нарушений безопасности на 57% и улучшение успешности задач на 0.13 по сравнению с базовым методом SafeVLA.

en.title: Enhancing Safety in Robotic VLA Models with ShieldVLA
en.desc: The paper introduces ShieldVLA, a new framework designed to enhance the safety of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models used in robotic tasks. It addresses the limitations of existing fine-tuning methods that often lead to unsafe behaviors or overly cautious actions due to soft penalties on costs. ShieldVLA utilizes Hamilton-Jacobi reachability to learn a safety critic from visual inputs, which helps in identifying safe operating regions for the robot. This approach not only improves safety by reducing cumulative costs but also increases the success rate of tasks without the need for manual safety annotations.

zh.title: ShieldVLA：提升VLA模型安全性的创新框架
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为ShieldVLA的安全对齐微调框架，旨在提高视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作和导航中的安全性。现有的微调方法主要依赖拉格朗日优化，容易导致安全约束的违反或过于保守的行为。ShieldVLA通过直接从视觉观察中学习哈密顿-雅可比（HJ）可达性值函数，来估计安全操作区域，从而优化策略。实验结果表明，ShieldVLA在多个基准测试中显著降低了安全成本，并提高了任务成功率。

papers.title: Prediction-Powered Smoothing and Validation for Disaggregated AI Evaluation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Evaluating an AI system requires disaggregated assessment, as performance varies across domains such as benchmark task types or conversation types in deployed agents. Exhaustive testing is expensive, so evaluation rests on a sample of labeled units. We treat the evaluation set as a finite population and seek accurate point and interval estimates of each domain mean. Direct estimators, including prediction-powered inference (PPI), use only a domain's own labels and are imprecise where labels are few. Small area estimation addresses this problem, and we build on it to develop an integrated workflow for estimation and validation. For estimation, we propose prediction-powered smoothing (PP-S), a Bayesian model fit to each domain's prediction-powered estimate, with an extension that borrows strength across a reporting taxonomy (PP-TS). For validation, we derive a new, approximately unbiased design-based cross-validation score for choosing among direct and smoothed estimators. We study a curated benchmark with verifiable grading and deployed agent traffic graded by humans, each with every outcome observed. In both, the proposed estimators improve on the direct estimators in point and interval estimation, with near-nominal coverage. At the same sampling budget, our score selects as well as an independent validation sample does and estimates the selected estimator's error far more accurately.
affiliations: Department of Statistics, University of California, Santa Cruz, CA, USA

ru.title: Умное сглаживание оценок AI через заимствование силы между доменами
ru.desc: В работе предлагается методология оценки систем искусственного интеллекта с разбиением по отдельным доменам, так как производительность варьируется в зависимости от типа задач и контекста применения. Авторы разработали prediction-powered smoothing (PP-S) — байесовский подход, который заимствует информацию между доменами для получения более точных оценок при ограниченном количестве размеченных данных. Для валидации предложен новый критерий кросс-валидации на основе дизайна выборки, который помогает выбрать лучший из прямых или сглаженных оценщиков без использования отдельной валидационной выборки. Экспериментальные результаты на бенчмарках и данных от развернутых агентов показывают, что предложенные методы значительно улучшают точность интервальных оценок и обеспечивают номинальное покрытие доверительных интервалов.

en.title: Enhancing AI Evaluation with Advanced Estimation Techniques
en.desc: This paper discusses the importance of evaluating AI systems through detailed assessments, as their performance can differ significantly across various tasks and conversation types. It highlights the challenges of exhaustive testing due to high costs, leading to reliance on a limited sample of labeled data for evaluation. The authors introduce a method called prediction-powered smoothing (PP-S), which enhances estimation accuracy by using Bayesian models and allows for sharing information across related domains. Additionally, they propose a new cross-validation score that helps in selecting the best estimation method, demonstrating improved performance over traditional direct estimators in both point and interval estimation.

zh.title: 提升AI评估准确性的创新方法
zh.desc: 本论文探讨了评估人工智能系统的有效方法，强调在不同领域中性能的差异。由于全面测试成本高昂，评估通常依赖于有限的标记样本。我们提出了一种基于贝叶斯模型的预测平滑方法（PP-S），并通过跨领域借力的扩展（PP-TS）来提高估计的准确性。研究表明，所提出的估计方法在点估计和区间估计上优于直接估计，且在相同的采样预算下，能够更准确地估计选择的估计器的误差。

papers.title: Streaming Video Editing with Easy Adaptation
papers.abstract: Abstract  In this paper, we propose SVEET, a framework that requires merely training on a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model but supports high-quality streaming video editing in an auto-regressive fashion. To tackle this problem, we first systematically revisit existing video-to-video diffusion approaches and identify two key principles for such streaming adaptation: backbone feature disentanglement and conditional frame independence. Building on these insights, we develop a novel paradigm for controllable video generation. At its core, an auxiliary model branch encodes source video inputs with temporally independent self-attention, and the intermediate features are injected into the corresponding backbone blocks for streaming-compatible control. Moreover, to bridge the discrepancy between the feature spaces of bidirectional and streaming models, we propose a decoupled training scheme that explicitly enforces the orthogonality between the optimization directions of video controllability and model causality. Such disentanglement ensures compatibility between the two objectives at inference and facilitates smooth zero-shot knowledge transfer across heterogeneous backbone architectures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SVEET achieves superior editing quality while maintaining real-time performance, attaining 15 FPS on a single H100 GPU 17 without any auxiliary acceleration techniques. Codes are available at https://github.com/YujiaHu1109/SVEET.

ru.title: Потоковое редактирование видео через разделение признаков в диффузионных моделях
ru.desc: В работе представлен фреймворк SVEET для потокового редактирования видео, основанный на предобученной двунаправленной модели диффузии. Авторы выявили два ключевых принципа адаптации для потокового режима: разделение признаков костяка сети и независимость условных кадров. Предложенный подход использует вспомогательную ветвь модели с временно независимым самовниманием для кодирования видео, при этом промежуточные признаки инжектируются в основные блоки сети. Разработана новая схема обучения с ортогональной регуляризацией, обеспечивающая совместимость между управляемостью видео и причинностью модели, что позволяет достичь высокого качества редактирования при реальной скорости обработки (15 FPS).

en.title: SVEET: Streamlined Video Editing with Enhanced Control
en.desc: This paper introduces SVEET, a new framework for high-quality streaming video editing using a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model. It emphasizes two main principles: disentangling backbone features and ensuring conditional frame independence for effective streaming adaptation. The framework employs a unique approach where an auxiliary model branch processes video inputs with self-attention, allowing for real-time control during video generation. The authors also present a decoupled training method that maintains the balance between video controllability and model causality, resulting in impressive editing quality at 15 frames per second on a single GPU.

zh.title: SVEET：高效流媒体视频编辑的新范式
zh.desc: 本文提出了SVEET框架，该框架仅需在预训练的双向视频扩散模型上进行训练，即可支持高质量的流媒体视频编辑。我们系统地回顾了现有的视频到视频扩散方法，并确定了流媒体适应的两个关键原则：主干特征解耦和条件帧独立性。基于这些见解，我们开发了一种新的可控视频生成范式，通过辅助模型分支对源视频输入进行时间独立的自注意力编码。实验表明，SVEET在保持实时性能的同时，实现了优越的编辑质量。

papers.title: UltraTex: Unleashing 2K Multi-View Diffusion for 3D Texturing
papers.abstract: Abstract  High-quality texture generation is essential for creating realistic and production-ready 3D assets. Recent multi-view diffusion methods have shown promising results for image-guided 3D texturing, but they are typically constrained to low operating resolutions such as 512 or 768, making it difficult to preserve high-frequency details from high-resolution reference images. Scaling this paradigm to 2048 resolution is computationally prohibitive, as the unified multi-view sequence exceeds 212K tokens and incurs excessive memory and latency. In this paper, we present UltraTex, an efficient end-to-end framework for high-resolution multi-view diffusion-based 3D texturing. Our key observation is that object-centric multi-view renderings contain two major sources of redundancy: background-induced sequence redundancy and sparse token interactions within the foreground. To address them, we introduce Background Token Dropping, which removes background tokens before the DiT backbone, and Block-Sparse Attention, which reduces attention computation over the retained foreground sequence. To enable efficient foreground-only inference while avoiding reconstruction artifacts, we further design Foreground-Aware VAE Decoding to ensure the quality of the final high-resolution views. To satisfy the demanding data requirements of 2K-resolution multi-view diffusion training, we construct G-buffer TexVerse, a large-scale, ultra-high-resolution multi-view rendering dataset covering over 268,000 3D assets. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates visually faithful textures with rich fine-grained details, while substantially improving efficiency, achieving 20.6times--91.1times training speedup and 22.3times--74.6times end-to-end inference speedup over the baseline on common samples in our dataset. Code and data is at https://yiboz2001.github.io/UltraTex.

ru.title: Масштабируемая генерация текстур: от фильтрации фона к детальным 3D активам
ru.desc: Авторы представляют UltraTex — эффективную систему для генерации высокотекстурированных 3D активов на основе диффузионных моделей. Ключевая идея состоит в выявлении и устранении избыточности в многовидовых последовательностях: они удаляют фоновые токены перед основной моделью и применяют блочно-разреженное внимание для оптимизации вычислений. Система использует специально разработанное декодирование VAE, чтобы сохранить качество финального высокого разрешения, и обучается на новом датасете G-buffer TexVerse с более чем 268000 трёхмерных активов. Предложенный подход достигает ускорения обучения в 20-91 раз и ускорения инференса в 22-74 раза по сравнению с базовыми методами.

en.title: UltraTex: Efficient High-Resolution 3D Texturing with Multi-View Diffusion
en.desc: This paper introduces UltraTex, a novel framework designed for efficient high-resolution 3D texturing using multi-view diffusion methods. The authors identify and address redundancies in multi-view renderings, specifically background sequence redundancy and sparse token interactions in the foreground. They propose techniques like Background Token Dropping and Block-Sparse Attention to enhance computational efficiency and maintain high-quality texture details. The framework is validated with a large dataset, TexVerse, and demonstrates significant improvements in training and inference speed while producing visually accurate textures.

zh.title: UltraTex：高效的高分辨率3D纹理生成框架
zh.desc: 高质量的纹理生成对创建逼真的3D资产至关重要。本文提出了一种名为UltraTex的高效端到端框架，旨在解决多视角扩散方法在高分辨率下的计算限制。我们通过引入背景令牌丢弃和块稀疏注意力机制，减少了冗余计算，从而提高了效率。实验表明，UltraTex在生成细致纹理的同时，训练速度提升了20.6到91.1倍，推理速度提升了22.3到74.6倍。

papers.title: TAPe+ML: A Compact Structured Representation for Multi-Task Computer Vision
papers.abstract: Abstract  We present TAPe+ML v3, a compact computer vision system based on TAPe (Theory of Active Perception), a structured representation that encodes relations among perceptual elements before recognition. Instead of operating directly on pixel tensors, the system uses a shared TAPe representation and a modular recognition architecture for image classification, object detection, and instance segmentation.   TAPe+ML v3 combines background and contour processing, local object localization, prototype-based classification, and a coordinator for specialized submodels. Across the reported experiments, it uses fewer than 100,000 parameters. On COCO object detection, it obtains 84.7 mAP50 and 65.3 mAP50-95. On COCO instance segmentation, it obtains 80.7 mask mAP50 and 58.4 mask mAP50-95. In classification experiments, it reaches 92 percent validation accuracy on Imagenette under an identical-training comparison with a raw-pixel baseline, and 89.9 percent Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-Real. We also evaluate compactness in video scene detection and adaptation under distribution shift in an industrial pilot. The results suggest that shifting part of the modeling burden from network parameters to a structured input representation can support compact multi-task vision systems with reduced data, memory, and compute requirements.
affiliations: Comexp Research Lab, TAPe + ML Project

ru.title: Структурированное восприятие вместо нейронных параметров
ru.desc: В статье представлена компактная система компьютерного зрения TAPe+ML v3, основанная на структурированном представлении TAPe, которое кодирует отношения между перцептивными элементами до процесса распознавания. Вместо прямой обработки пиксельных тензоров система использует общее представление TAPe и модульную архитектуру для классификации изображений, детекции объектов и сегментации экземпляров. Модель сочетает обработку фона и контуров, локализацию объектов и классификацию на основе прототипов, требуя менее 100 тысяч параметров. Результаты демонстрируют, что перенос части нагрузки моделирования со стороны параметров сети на структурированное представление входных данных позволяет создавать компактные мультизадачные системы зрения с меньшими требованиями к данным, памяти и вычислительным ресурсам.

en.title: Efficient Vision with TAPe+ML v3: Less is More!
en.desc: TAPe+ML v3 is a compact computer vision system that utilizes the Theory of Active Perception (TAPe) to represent perceptual elements in a structured way before recognition. Instead of processing raw pixel data, it employs a shared TAPe representation along with a modular architecture for tasks like image classification, object detection, and instance segmentation. The system achieves impressive performance metrics while using fewer than 100,000 parameters, demonstrating its efficiency in various tasks such as COCO object detection and ImageNet classification. The findings indicate that by leveraging structured input representations, TAPe+ML v3 can effectively reduce the computational and memory demands of multi-task vision systems.

zh.title: 紧凑型多任务视觉系统的创新
zh.desc: 本文介绍了TAPe+ML v3，这是一个基于TAPe（主动感知理论）的紧凑型计算机视觉系统。该系统通过共享的TAPe表示和模块化识别架构进行图像分类、物体检测和实例分割，而不是直接处理像素张量。TAPe+ML v3结合了背景和轮廓处理、局部物体定位、基于原型的分类以及专门子模型的协调器。实验结果表明，通过将部分建模负担从网络参数转移到结构化输入表示，可以支持紧凑的多任务视觉系统，减少数据、内存和计算需求。

papers.title: EDGEGEN: Improving Tool-Calling Agents Beyond Happy Paths with Synthetic Edge Case Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Tool-calling LLM agents are increasingly deployed in enterprise applications. However, effective evaluation and optimization require high-quality, diverse task datasets that are often difficult to obtain due to privacy and other constraints. Existing synthetic task generation methods often produce generic tasks that ignore an agent's underlying state or database and fail to reflect real-world usage diversity. We propose EdgeGen, a synthetic task generation framework that extracts compliance rules from an agent's specification and uses them to generate database-grounded edge-case tasks designed to violate these rules. When combined with existing synthetic data generation techniques, EdgeGen enables agent improvement through finetuning and harness optimization. The resulting pipeline forms a fully automated closed-loop system that requires no human annotation. Finetuning on data generated by EdgeGen yields a consistent mean progress improvement of 2 percent to 42 percent on tau2bench airline domain, while other baseline methods show degradation for some models. On the other hand, for harness optimization, our method shows a mean progress improvement of 10 percent and 30 percent over the human-curated and base harnesses, respectively, for the Gemma-4-e4b model.

ru.title: Автоматическая генерация граничных случаев для оптимизации агентов LLM
ru.desc: В статье представлена EdgeGen — фреймворк для синтетической генерации задач, предназначенный для обучения агентов на основе LLM с использованием инструментов. Метод извлекает правила соответствия из спецификации агента и генерирует граничные случаи, которые нарушают эти правила и привязаны к реальным базам данных. Синтетические данные, полученные EdgeGen, используются для файнтюнинга моделей и оптимизации промптов в полностью автоматизированном цикле без участия человека. Экспериментальные результаты показывают значительное улучшение производительности агентов (от 2% до 42% на бенчмарке tau2bench) по сравнению с существующими методами синтетической генерации данных.

en.title: EdgeGen: Elevating Agent Performance with Targeted Task Generation
en.desc: This paper introduces EdgeGen, a framework for generating synthetic tasks that are specifically designed to challenge machine learning agents by violating compliance rules derived from their specifications. Unlike traditional methods that create generic tasks, EdgeGen focuses on producing edge-case scenarios that reflect real-world complexities and diversity. The framework automates the task generation process, eliminating the need for human annotation, and allows for effective finetuning and optimization of agents. Results show significant performance improvements in agent capabilities, demonstrating EdgeGen's effectiveness in enhancing machine learning applications in enterprise settings.

zh.title: EdgeGen：提升LLM代理性能的合成任务生成框架
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为EdgeGen的合成任务生成框架，旨在为工具调用的LLM代理生成高质量的任务数据集。EdgeGen通过提取代理规范中的合规规则，生成基于数据库的边缘案例任务，这些任务旨在违反这些规则，从而反映真实世界的使用多样性。与现有的合成数据生成技术结合后，EdgeGen能够通过微调和优化提升代理的性能。实验结果表明，使用EdgeGen生成的数据在航空领域的微调中，平均进步提高了2%到42%。
